tools.name: decode_graph_url
tools.description: Decode an equation.io link (either the #-fragment form or the /g/ share form) into its list of equation rows, so you can edit them and build a new link with encode_graph_url.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url · Public sink: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url, show_graph.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url · Public sink: encode_graph_url, decode_graph_url, show_graph

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
